name: Hunan Boyun New Materials Co.,Ltd
summary: Hunan Boyun New Materials Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of aircraft wheel brake systems and brake materials, and carbon composite materials for aerospace, cemented carbide, and rare metal powder materials in China and internationally. The company operates through two segments: Aerospace and Carbon/Carbon Composites Business and powder metallurgy business. The company serves aviation, aerospace, and civil industrial sectors. Hunan Boyun New Materials Co.,Ltd was founded in 2001 and is based in Changsha, China.
